releases.name: v1.14.0
releases.notes:
## Features
- dra allocator implementation (#3082) [#3082](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3082) ([Jason Deal](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/961af74bda8ee253f253494bcbca003e3b0eb150))

## Bug Fixes
- use namespaced name as resourceclaim index (#3102) [#3102](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3102) ([Jason Deal](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/fe46f5c0f2ca0d59fdbb775e78e72ec72bc3aaa7))
- ResourceClaim hydration deadlock (#3122) [#3122](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3122) ([Ryan Mistretta](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/d7a4e1e629c815deb92e73cf299aad47c8a5888b))

- add Clever Cloud provider to README (#3099) [#3099](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3099) ([diodonfrost](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/32e96ad4435d859473df9bc33167aeb1495c7a8e))

- InPlacePodVerticalScaling Support RFC (#3037) [#3037](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3037) ([Jigisha Patil](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/4a2d93908c01d9852c69df3673b7c7a1071596c9))

## Performance Improvements
- memory optimizations in cluster cost tracking (#3068) [#3068](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3068) ([Ryan Mistretta](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/da3a050dc50a52f97313357b2478e1653b6fc1a4))

## Tests
- replace metrics collection and calibrate resource utilization thresholds for perf tests (#3048) [#3048](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3048) ([Andrew Mitchell](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/8cd2a4016335ecb1456aaedbeea4833f2f371b3c))
- add Capacity Buffers integ tests (#3044) [#3044](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3044) ([Sumukha Radhakrishna](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/cb50f815613d755397a532c3ab079c519550bbe7))

## Chores
- support consumable capacity and partitionable device fields in core DRA types (#3097) [#3097](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3097) ([Ryan Mistretta](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/2a7dbd24e376f3dc8ef2dd1e6339b57522f8267d))
- add managed dimension to node and pod metrics (#3091) [#3091](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3091) ([Andrew Mitchell](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/e21d298fa0c1b4e55c6b822a1e70b44101f8ae19))
- make Buffer expectations provider/env agnostic (#3114) [#3114](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3114) ([Sumukha Radhakrishna](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/1922ddc3358706a274f36e71a6c0a296f457b063))
- update go-opentelemetry dependencies (#3123) [#3123](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3123) ([Sumukha Radhakrishna](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/14900f21b1655702c05da09d570ba4752baa2304))
- use status resources in pod resource calculation (#3065) [#3065](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3065) ([Jigisha Patil](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/edccab9f02bf03e8bda3a76377c200fe29f2343a))
- make NodeClaim launch timeout configurable (#3112) [#3112](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/pull/3112) ([Andrew Mitchell](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/karpenter/commit/d9e28e932331b14a6e4e0f106a5d2d8ff4e015dd))
